# SprintCo Knowledge Base

Company Name: SprintCo
Website: https://www.sprint-co.com

Company Overview:
SprintCo is an F&B-focused design and build company helping restaurant, cafe, bar, and QSR brands create scalable customer experiences through design, branding, engineering, and modular construction.

Mission:
To help restaurant brands move from concept to scale through efficient design-build systems and operationally focused spaces.

Services:

1. Concept Design
- Restaurant layouts
- Customer journey planning
- Space optimization
- Operational planning

2. Brand Identity & Strategy
- Naming
- Logo design
- Visual identity
- Packaging systems
- Brand storytelling

3. Rollout & Expansion
- Multi-location standardisation
- Design replication
- Franchise rollout support

4. MEP Design
- Mechanical planning
- Electrical planning
- Plumbing planning
- Commercial kitchen coordination

5. FlatPack Build
- Modular construction
- Faster project execution
- Scalable deployment systems

6. Restaurant Consulting
- Design audits
- Concept validation
- Expansion strategy

Industries Served:
- Restaurants
- Cafes
- QSR Chains
- Fine Dining
- Bars
- Cloud Kitchens
- Food Courts
- Hospitality
